title: Native static network attachment authorization v1
description: Exact canonical sorted compact ensure_ascii JSON (including escaped DEL), no LF, at most 32768 bytes and depth 6. Ed25519 signs the payload schema ASCII, NUL, and exact canonical payload. Signed constraints are not actual host/child ownership, a durable claim, network readback, reachability, workload start or recovery permission. Actual parent admission requires the exact signed egress v3 grant with manual-dual-stack-no-autoconfiguration-v1 before child creation.

ip.description: Canonical unicast IP, never unspecified/multicast/IPv4 broadcast, IPv4-mapped IPv6 or a zone-suffixed address. Runtime enforces canonical packed-address semantics.

lock.description: Signed preprovisioned root:root0600 empty single-link regular file. Actual owner holds a nonblocking exclusive lock and verifies held/named identity through all effects. Path and device/inode must differ from the attachment journal directory. This is cooperative local locking, not hostile-root exclusion.

bridge.description: Exact preprovisioned gateway bridge in the authenticated launcher-host namespace. Actual readback must prove every signed gateway address is already on this bridge and each selected child IP already has a permanent host bridge neighbor mapping to the signed child MAC. The backend never creates those host addresses/neighbors/routes or NAT.

route.description: One exact signed proxy destination only, with fixed host prefix /32 or /128, static MAIN254 UNICAST route, metric1024, ONLINK and the selected same-family child preferred source. gatewayMacAddress must equal bridge.macAddress; the child receives a permanent neighbor entry. No default route, DNS route or implicit remote connected route.

attachment.description: Exclusive new veth pair, both links UP only through the fixed claimed backend. All three bridge/host/child names and MACs differ; MTU does not exceed bridge MTU. Exactly one address per used family; addresses/routes sort IPv4 before IPv6 by packed bytes, with unique destinations. Every address family has a route and vice versa; child addresses cannot equal gateways/destinations. Fixed NOPREFIXROUTE and IPv6 NODAD/addr_gen_mode NONE; no automatic addresses or unsigned route expansion. Only exact kernel-derived local/multicast state is normalized by the typed readback profile, not accepted as arbitrary extra remote routing.

payload.description: Exact30 fields with16 nonzero digest commitments. Positive current i64 nanoseconds, expires>issued, at most300s and contained in capability expiry; parent additionally joins complete original egress/setup/delegation lifetimes. Source configuration/host scope is not actual future child identity: genuine child namespace, fresh proof and exact intended operation enter the purpose-separated durable operation association. Parent must enforce independent root/token/capability and journal path/device-inode/namespace roles against creation/kernel/CA purposes.
